svg.title: Renewing the pictures
svg.desc: A pull request that changes a file of screenshots-paths.txt, such as the CSS or a template, runs the visual check. scripts/screenshots.sh renders every screenshot and the social preview from the demo, with the same clock and data in every run, and the comparison of the screenshot bot keeps each picture whose pixels stayed the same. When pixels changed, one comment on the pull request lists the pictures, with an artifact of each before and after and the changed pixels in red. After the merge, after each release, every week and on demand, the screenshot bot renders the pictures on main the same way. When pixels changed, it keeps one pull request, docs: update the screenshots, which merges itself once every check passes; when the social preview is among them, it asks to upload it in the settings of the repository.
